title: Domino Apocalypse
description: A surreal scene featuring a skeleton in a plaid shirt pushing a line of giant red dominoes down psychedelic stairs, while a green frog with a domino on its head sits on a lily pad in the foreground. In the sky, a massive blue serpent with multiple skulls spirals around a glowing domino sun above a colorful cityscape blending Roman ruins, a cathedral, and graffiti-covered walls.
